data.description: If destroyed, the herald it returns to unlife 1 hour later at 1 hit point, allowing its fast healing to resume healing it. It can be permanently destroyed by positive energy, being reduced to 0 hit points in the area of a Bless or Hallow spell, or if 20 vials of holy water are sprinkled on its remains.
